vernacular_zh: 群龙都刚健有力，却没有一条争着做首领，这是吉祥的。
translation_en: If the host of dragons (thus) appearing were to divest themselves of their heads, there would be good fortune.

scripture.text_zh: 在你们中间，谁愿为首，就必作众人的仆人。因为人子来，并不是要受人的服事，乃是要服事人。
scripture.text_en: And whosoever of you will be the chiefest, shall be servant of all. For even the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister.

note_zh: 乾卦中的龙是阳刚、君子、圣王的象征。
note_en: In Qian, the dragon symbolizes yang strength, the noble person and the sage-king.
insight_zh: 易经：不争为首，**无首则吉**；耶稣：甘作仆人，**反为元首**。
insight_en: I Ching: none contends to lead, **and it is good**. Jesus: the servant of all **becomes the Head**.
